projects.title: AER 27 Suspension Kinematics
projects.summary: Double-wishbone cantilever suspension for the AER 27 car, designed in Optimum Kinematics.
projects.description:
Fully designed a double-wishbone cantilever suspension system for the AER 27 vehicle using Optimum Kinematics. Modified rear kinematics for packaging with minimal modifications to the performance of the vehicle.

A reduction in the chassis length in the rear called for major design changes in the rear of the vehicle, causing pickup points to move forward by up to 200mm.

Optimized kinematics for camber gain, damper lengths, motion ratio, bump steer, and rocker angle.

projects.title: Glazz Home Presence System
projects.summary: Waterproof 3D-printed enclosure for a startup's AI home presence and safety device.
projects.description:
Contract work for a small startup developing an AI smart home presence and safety system.

- Designed and built the device's waterproof enclosure in SolidWorks, 3D printing each iteration on a BambuLab P1S
- ASA filament for UV resistance and strength, with a TPU gasket for IP68 sealing
- Ran waterproofing tests throughout the design process
- Wrote full assembly documentation and weekly engineering invention memos
- Presented designs weekly to the team and to potential investors
